<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks at 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (two signals), and 128.30 (two signals) fall within the typical aromatic carbon region (≈110–160 ppm). That accounts for 6 distinct aromatic carbon signals. The remaining peaks are aliphatic. Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
